Are you an experienced roofer or roof tiler looking for a varied job where craftsmanship, teamwork, and quality come first? Then we'd love to meet you!

Your working day starts at our warehouse in Oudkarspel, where you meet your colleagues to go over the day's schedule and prepare the materials needed for the project. Together, you travel to the job site where you'll be working from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM renovating the roofs of existing homes.

No two days are the same. One day you'll be removing an old roof structure, while the next you'll be installing new roof tiles, fitting insulation materials, or carrying out various carpentry tasks. Every project offers new challenges, and at the end of the day, you'll see the results of your craftsmanship reflected in the finished roof.

You'll be part of a close-knit and supportive team where everyone works together to deliver high-quality results. Helping one another comes naturally, and safety, quality, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do.

We also believe in investing in our people. That's why we offer plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career. You'll have the chance to obtain certifications such as VCA, MEWP (Mobile Elevated Work Platform), and crane operator certificates, as well as attend a range of professional training courses to further expand your expertise.

Are you an experienced roofer or roof tiler who enjoys working outdoors, takes pride in delivering quality workmanship, and thrives in a team environment? We'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact us for more information!

- You have experience with roofing work
- You have your own transport to the warehouse in Oudkarspel
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are willing to work in a team

 IT Traineeship 9 November 2026 
Start your IT-career with Motopp 
Over the course of 27 weeks, you will prepare, together with eleven other trainees, for a career in the Dutch IT sector. How? Through a combination of technical IT skills training, insights into Dutch work culture, and workshops to develop essential soft skills. You will learn software development, gain an understanding of how the workplace operates in the Netherlands, and participate in sessions on topics such as presenting, assertiveness, and teamwork. The traineeship is fulltime and conducted in English. 
After completing the training, we will start mediation towards a paid job at one of our partner companies across the country. If we find a match, for the next 18 months we will continue to support you with personal coaching sessions, evaluations, and additional workshops. 
Step-by-Step Program - Basic Training (2 weeks): Learn about Dutch work culture, communication, presentation techniques, CV building, and get introduced to Agile/Scrum methodologies. - IT Bootcamp (12 weeks): Consists of three modules: Business IT (Project Management, Business Requirements, Artificial Intelligence), Back-end Development (Python, FastAPI, DevOps), and IT Principles (Testing, ITL, Cloud Computing, Information Security). Trainees develop technical skills and explore their ideal IT role. - Internal Internship (12 weeks): Apply your knowledge in a simulated Dutch Agile work environment at Motopp, work on applications in Sprints, and receive feedback from trainers and mentors. - Career: We do not offer a 100% job guarantee, but we do offer 100% job intention. Once you're ready to start working, you'll be matched with a position that aligns with your experience and skills, such as a software developer, system administrator, or business analyst.
